name: EuProductNumber
title: EU product number
description: An EU product number, EU/1/YY/NNN (an authorisation number without its presentation), as a MedicinalProductDefinition's identifier. https://khs.dev/fhir/StructureDefinition/eu-product-identity holds every value to ^EU/1/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{3,4}$, and to the products of the RegulatedAuthorizations' numbers (khs-eu-2, khs-eu-4).
